newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan T$30 bln gov't bond average yield 6.336 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan T$30 bln gov't bond average yield 6.336 pct.

text.p: TAIPEI, March 7 (Reuter) Taiwan's finance ministry said on Friday it auctioned T$30 billion in 15-year government construction bonds with an average yield of 6.336 percent.
The range of the yield was between 6.300 percent and 6.353 percent, a ministry official said.
Demand totalled T$60.96 billion, the official said.
The central bank completed the auction on behalf of the finance ministry.
